verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a skill pack for coding agents, so background automation is a fair axis to ask about. The closest capability is the Ralph loop, which executes "exactly one explicitly assigned" Ledger task to a validated commit and is framed as delivering one bounded task. The pack documents no scheduled, triggered, or continuously running background automations; the Ledger skills only manage tasks, dependencies and ready-ordering for agents to pick up.
